name: graph-paper-tall
title: Graph paper
description: A faint squared grid on off-white paper that fades towards the edges, cut tall for phones. It loops with no join.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Ruled lines, a dot at each crossing, or a plus mark at each crossing.

props.name: line
props.doc: Line width (or dot radius), in pixels.

props.name: major
props.doc: A stronger line every this many cells; 0 for none.

props.name: strength
props.doc: How dark the grid is over the paper.

props.name: focusX
props.doc: Where the grid is strongest, across (0 left, 1 right).

props.name: focusY
props.doc: Where the grid is strongest, down (0 top, 1 bottom).

props.name: fade
props.doc: How far from the focus the grid has faded out, as a fraction of the frame height. 2 for no fade.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Cells the grid slides per loop. Whole numbers, so it loops.

props.name: light
props.doc: How much the corners darken round a soft light.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Grain amount over the whole frame.
